scope: R5 to R7 spring-clip carrier and XIAO holder; all battery variants, matching print exports and preview
result: Source and final geometry reviewed; all final geometry and sliced-clearance checks passed. Physical fit, elastic force and fatigue remain unverified.
preserved: five-key positions and flat switch/socket seats
three battery options and reserve envelope
XIAO PCB and USB orientation, with clear wire route
shared free-orbit viewer controls and explicit wheel override
intentional_changes: nearly closed C spring curves, 7.9 mm relaxed bore for nominal 8 mm tube
rounded 1 mm free arms, 1.6 mm carrier roots and 1.4 mm sensor roots
rear battery roots route around free arms; rear far clip moved 3 mm axially
six spring fit coupons, three key coupons and one combined centre test piece
iterations: Initial sensor hoop replacement disconnected its roots; restored upper connections and verified one closed body.
An added lower-arm clearance probe found rear cradle reinforcement and an end rail stiffened the arms; rerouted the roots and separated the far clip, then reran exports, clearances and slicing.
Used source Boolean geometry for the arm-relief subtraction, separately verifying exported clip bands and sliced model paths, to avoid coincident float32 subtraction artifacts.
